ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 75% low-intensity (black) pixels concentrated centrally and proximally, with 25% high-intensity (white) pixels localized at the distal lobe tips.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Centralized, contiguous black region extending from the peduncle through the medial fluke sections. High-intensity white regions are restricted to the outer distal lobes and contain significant black focal spotting and mottling, particularly dense on the right lobe tip.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central depression with a clearly defined acute angle vertex.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Highly irregular continuous boundary with high-frequency serrations across both lobes; right lobe displays higher-amplitude, more jagged pixel-level peaks and valleys compared to the left lobe.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Outer edges exhibit convex mathematical curves sweeping upward and outward from the central axis.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Clusters of dark circular pixels visible within the white distal zones; scattered high-contrast white circular spots (pitting) localized on the central black regions.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Densely distributed network of fine, high-contrast white linear marks (rake marks) of varying lengths and trajectories crossing the low-intensity central pigmentation.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive textured biofouling and irregular scarring at the distal-most tips of both lobes; multiple deep, non-uniform notches along the trailing edge indicative of physical trauma.
other_distinctive_markers: Distinctive brownish-yellow textured pixel clusters (consistent with biofouling) localized at the extreme lateral tips of the fluke.
